why: Intro to Docker plan, 'Run your first container' (passes: docker ps -a lists a hello-world container that exited with code 0). The learner ran `docker pull hello-world` instead of `docker run hello-world`: the image is downloaded (docker images lists it) but no container was ever made. docker ps -a shows only an old docker/getting-started container, whose 'Exited (0)' is what the exit-code check sees.

step.title: Run hello-world and find its container
step.instructions: Run your first container with docker run hello-world. It prints a greeting and stops. Then list every container, stopped ones too, with docker ps -a.
